description: Shared test corpus for every mama scoring implementation. Each case is engine-agnostic: expected values are the assess() output on the v2 scale. Every implementation (Python measuring_autonomy.score, site/scoring.js) must reproduce every case exactly; CI runs a checker per implementation and blocks release on drift. Bump corpus_version together with ruleset_version on any scoring change.

cases.name: worked-example-formalize
cases.description: Worked example (examples/README.md): no formal grant, shadow autonomy found

expect.recommended_move: formalize: write a contract at the safe level before any change

cases.name: submarine-no-grant
cases.description: All-zero profile with no grant: nothing is safe to grant

expect.recommended_move: submarine: no autonomy is safe to grant yet — build guardrails, telemetry, and accountability before any contract

cases.name: submarine-held
cases.description: All-zero profile, current = L0 (Submarine Line): hold and build

expect.recommended_move: hold at the Submarine Line (L0): no autonomy is safe to grant yet; build guardrails, telemetry, and accountability

cases.name: formalize-from-submarine
cases.description: current = L0 but safety dimensions support a grant: write the first contract

expect.recommended_move: formalize: write the first contract at the safe level (L3)

cases.name: hold-stable
cases.description: All dimensions at 4, granted L4: hold

expect.recommended_move: hold: stable at the current level; re-review next horizon
notes_contain: granted level matches safe level: hold and review

cases.name: hold-and-coach
cases.description: D1/D2 lag the safety floor: coaching signal, keep the grant

expect.recommended_move: hold and coach: capability/clarity lag; keep the grant

cases.name: over-grant
cases.description: Granted L4 but D3 = 2: over-grant, contract or re-shape

expect.recommended_move: contract or re-shape: safety dimensions lag the grant
notes_contain: over-grant: granted level exceeds safe level by 2

cases.name: headroom-expand
cases.description: Safe L4, granted L3: headroom, expand after clean cycles

expect.recommended_move: expand (after 2 clean cycles): raise one level or widen scope in the strongest dimension
notes_contain: headroom: safe level exceeds granted level by 1

cases.name: submarine-dimension-floor
cases.description: One zero safety dimension (D4) grounds the grant at the Submarine Line even at granted L5

expect.recommended_move: contract or re-shape: safety dimensions lag the grant

invalid_inputs.description: Rejected by the Python engine's parse/validation (the JS engine has no score-vector parser; JS coverage is the scoreDimension ladder logic in tools/site_selftest.js).
